name: Embodied Chain-of-Thought
summary: ECoT trains a VLA to emit a structured reasoning chain grounded in the scene (task restatement, sub-task, motion primitive, visible object bounding boxes, predicted gripper pixel position) before producing action tokens. Reasoning supervision is generated automatically by pipelines of off-the-shelf detectors and LLMs, and the resulting policy improves absolute success by roughly 28% over OpenVLA while exposing an inspectable trace a human can correct.
innovation: Reasoning steps grounded in spatial predictions such as boxes and gripper pixels, not just free text.
Fully automatic generation of reasoning supervision from existing robot data.
Interpretability as a control surface: humans can read and edit the chain to fix behavior.
matters: Imported chain-of-thought, the biggest LLM capability gain, into embodied control with real grounding.
limits: Generating the chain costs inference time, cutting control rate substantially.
lineage: OpenVLA trained with automatically generated, spatially grounded reasoning traces.
